Metadata.Goal: Plan and stage Kunun type-system evolution for first-class enum/value support, a separate annotation/metadata extension package, and reusable schema/ontology row-kernel support.
Metadata.Description: Analyze the existing ExtensibleScopedRowType-based type-system implementation and split enum/value, annotation metadata, and schema/ontology RFC requirements into bounded tracks.

TaskSpace.name: evolve-type-system-for-enum-and-schema-ontology
TaskSpace.Description: Iterative mission for adding enum/value, a batteries-included annotation package, and schema/ontology concepts while preserving the existing scoped row core.

TaskGroup.name: Baseline audit and behavior framing
TaskGroup.Description: Turn the current reading into durable baseline behavior and implementation inventory.

Task.name: Create RFC baseline track
Task.Description: Create a track that records behavior deltas for enum/value, annotation/metadata, and schema/ontology requirements, plus a source-level inventory of current type-system seams.

Task.name: Confirm implementation boundaries
Task.Description: Confirm which work belongs in core type-system model, the new annotation package, binder/checker, typed runtime, and external domain adapters.

TaskGroup.name: Enum/value MVP
TaskGroup.Description: Add first-class closed enum types and scoped enum values as the smaller nominal-symbol feature.

Task.name: Create enum/value implementation track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for EnumTypeSymbol, EnumValueSymbol, registry APIs, binder support, checker compatibility, and focused tests.

Task.name: Verify enum migration shape
Task.Description: Verify native !RecordStatus usage, raw string rejection, duplicate value diagnostics, and optional Enum<T> migration compatibility.

TaskGroup.name: Annotation package foundation
TaskGroup.Description: Create the batteries-included annotation/metadata package before schema constraints depend on required/storage/description metadata.

Task.name: Create type annotations package track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for the new kunun-type-annotations workspace package, annotation extraction, normalized metadata bags, built-in vocabulary, and package-boundary tests.

Task.name: Verify annotation boundary
Task.Description: Verify that required, description, storage representation, labels, source visibility, and migration hints are interpreted by kunun-type-annotations rather than hard-coded in type-system core.

TaskGroup.name: Schema core foundation
TaskGroup.Description: Add core schema infrastructure that affects type identity or compatibility, while keeping annotation vocabulary in the extension package.

Task.name: Create branded scalar track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for BrandedScalarTypeSymbol identity and conversion boundaries without storage metadata policy in core.

Task.name: Create schema alias registry track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for canonicalization, type/relation/attribute aliases, scoped attribute aliases, and alias cycle diagnostics.

Task.name: Create schema type and mixin track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for SchemaTypeSymbol, SchemaMixinSymbol, effective rows, precedence, nominal schema subtyping, and core value-type override safety.

Task.name: Verify effective attribute semantics
Task.Description: Verify origins, mixin non-subtyping, parent graph subtype checks, and value-type override diagnostics; defer required/optional policy to annotation profiles.

TaskGroup.name: Relations, queries, and provider boundary
TaskGroup.Description: Add first-class relation schema, schema query helpers, and a boundary for external schema facts.

Task.name: Create annotation constraint profile track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track in kunun-type-annotations for required/optional tightening, storage/domain metadata interpretation, and schema profile diagnostics.

Task.name: Create relation and query set track
Task.Description: Create and execute a track for RelationTypeSymbol, endpoint compatibility, exact/polymorphic type-set APIs, aggregate pre-checks, and SchemaFactProvider interfaces.

Task.name: Check provider and runtime adapter boundaries
Task.Description: Verify that external schema stores remain providers/adapters, annotation metadata stays outside type-system core, and default untyped runtime behavior is unchanged.

TaskGroup.name: Integration verification and closeout
TaskGroup.Description: Verify the combined enum and schema work against domain-shaped fixtures and prepare durable knowledge promotion.

Task.name: Create integration verification track
Task.Description: Create and execute a verification track using ORM-shaped enum fixtures and Cozo-OM-shaped schema fixtures.

Task.name: Promote stable behavior and decisions
Task.Description: Promote accepted behavior deltas, durable decisions, and implementation knowledge according to Codument archive and knowledge-tier rules.
